facts.fact: Bridge the Digital Divide Sierra Leone, the ITU Digital Transformation Centre, trained 600 citizens in a 20-day basic digital skills course, funded by ITU and Norway, per ITU Academy.

facts.fact: UNCDF's national baseline survey gives adult digital literacy at 26 of 100 points, with 25% of adults able to save or delete phone contacts and 21.5% able to send text messages.
